48647-the-mornin-glory-girl.title: The Mornin’-Glory Girl
48647-the-mornin-glory-girl.creator: ALICE M. WINLOW and KATHRYN POCKLINGTON
48647-the-mornin-glory-girl.description: A book by ALICE M. WINLOW and KATHRYN POCKLINGTON. The dutiful husband drew from his pocket a long slip of paper and a small stubby pencil. Having a poor memory, he had formed the habit of making a note of everything his wife suggested, so that he could fulfill her wishes in future. The notes were plentiful, but they failed in some unaccountable way to prod his memory.

6978-made-over-dishes.title: Made Over Dishes
6978-made-over-dishes.creator: Unknown
6978-made-over-dishes.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Save for stock, every bone, whether beef, mutton, poultry or game, as well as all the juices that are left in the meat carving dishes on the table, and the water in which meats are boiled and in which certain vegetables are boiled.

79384-recluses.title: Recluses
79384-recluses.creator: Raymond S. Spears
79384-recluses.description: A book by Raymond S. Spears. Queen would go to a near-by knoll and sit on her haunches, surveying the surrounding country. She kept her nose horizontal, however, and no coyote howl ever tempted her to point her jaws up, howling in answer. It remained for a dog-wolf, a gray roamer of perhaps her own age, to come by at last; and between suns she vanished from the sportsmen’s camp.

arxiv-2106-09303.title: A Multi-task convolutional neural network for blind stereoscopic image quality assessment using naturalness analysis
arxiv-2106-09303.creator: Salima Bourbia, Ayoub Karine, Aladine Chetouani, Mohammed El Hassouni
arxiv-2106-09303.description: Abstract This paper addresses the problem of blind stereoscopic image quality assessment (NR-SIQA) using a new multi-task deep learning based-method. In the field of stereoscopic vision, the information is fairly distributed between the left and right views as well as the binocular phenomenon.

arxiv-2112-10690.title: Adversarially Robust Stability Certificates can be Sample-Efficient
arxiv-2112-10690.creator: Thomas T.C.K. Zhang, Stephen Tu, Nicholas M. Boffi, Jean-Jacques E. Slotine, Nikolai Matni
arxiv-2112-10690.description: Abstract Motivated by bridging the simulation to reality gap in the context of safety-critical systems, we consider learning adversarially robust stability certificates for unknown nonlinear dynamical systems. In line with approaches from robust control, we consider additive and Lipschitz bounded adversaries that perturb the system dynamics.

arxiv-2211-05429.title: DrawMon: A Distributed System for Detection of Atypical Sketch Content in Concurrent Pictionary Games Conference: Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia; October 10–14, 2022; Lisboa, Portugal Proceedings of the 30th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (MM ’22), Oct
arxiv-2211-05429.creator: Nikhil Bansal, Kartik Gupta, Kiruthika Kannan, Sivani Pentapati, Ravi Kiran Sarvadevabhatla
arxiv-2211-05429.description: Abstract . Pictionary, the popular sketch-based guessing game, provides an opportunity to analyze shared goal cooperative game play in restricted communication settings. However, some players occasionally draw atypical sketch content. While such content is occasionally relevant in the game context, it sometimes represents a rule violation and impairs the game experience.

arxiv-2311-16110.title: Community Battery Energy Storage Systems for Enhancing Distribution System Operation: A Multi-objective Optimization Approach Thanks: This work was supported in part by the Australian Research Council (ARC) Discovery Early Career Researcher Award (DECRA) under Grant DE230100046. *Corresponding autho
arxiv-2311-16110.creator: Yunqi Wang 1,2 , Hao Wang 1,2* , Markus Wagner 1,2 , Ariel Liebman 1,2
arxiv-2311-16110.description: Abstract The growing penetration of distributed energy resources (DERs) in distribution networks (DNs) raises new operational challenges, particularly in terms of reliability and voltage regulation. In response to these challenges, we introduce an innovative DN operation framework with multi-objective optimization, leveraging community battery energy storage systems (C-BESS).

arxiv-2406-04125.title: Particle creation using the classical stochastic method
arxiv-2406-04125.creator: Takayuki Hirayama
arxiv-2406-04125.description: Abstract We compute the particle creation of a harmonic oscillator using the classical stochastic method. This recently constructed method reproduces all the vacuum expectation values in quantum theory. We prepare the vacuum state at the initial time and evolve it over time using Langevin equations of motion.

arxiv-2412-20933.title: ProtScan: Modeling and Prediction of RNA-Protein Interactions
arxiv-2412-20933.creator: Gianluca Corrado, Michael Uhl, Rolf Backofen, Andrea Passerini, Fabrizio Costa
arxiv-2412-20933.description: Abstract Motivation: CLIP-seq methods are valuable techniques to experimentally determine transcriptome-wide binding sites of RNA-binding proteins. Despite the constant improvement of such techniques (e.g. eCLIP), the results are affected by various types of noise and depend on experimental conditions such as cell line, tissue, gene expression levels, stress conditions etc.

arxiv-2503-15974.title: Thermal resonance-enhanced transparency in room temperature Rydberg gases
arxiv-2503-15974.creator: Jinlian Hu, Yuechun Jiao, Yuwen Yin, Cheng Lu, Jingxu Bai, Suotang Jia, Weibin Li, Zhengyang Bai, Jianming Zhao
arxiv-2503-15974.description: Abstract We report the enhanced optical transmission in the coherent, off-resonant excitation of Rydberg atom gases at room temperature via a two-photon process. Here thermal resonance-enhanced transparency (TRET) is induced when the detuning of the two lasers is adjusted to compensate the atomic thermal-motion-induced energy shifts, i.e. single and two-photon Doppler shifts.

arxiv-2506-10161.title: Can LLMs Generate Good Stories? Insights and Challenges from a Narrative Planning Perspective
arxiv-2506-10161.creator: Yi Wang, Max Kreminski
arxiv-2506-10161.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yi Wang, Max Kreminski. Story generation has been a prominent application of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, understanding LLMs’ ability to produce high-quality stories remains limited due to challenges in automatic evaluation methods and the high cost and subjectivity of manual evaluation. Computational narratology offers valuable insights into what constitutes a good story, which has been applied in the symbolic narrative planning approach to story generation.

arxiv-2510-09690.title: A Semantic Model for Audit of Cloud Engines based on ISO/IEC TR 3445:2022
arxiv-2510-09690.creator: Morteza Sargolzaei Javan
arxiv-2510-09690.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Morteza Sargolzaei Javan. Cloud computing has become the foundation of modern digital infrastructure, yet the absence of a unified architectural and compliance framework impedes interoperability, auditability, and robust security. This paper introduces a formal, machine-readable semantic model for Cloud Engines, integrating the architectural taxonomy of ISO/IEC 22123 (Cloud Reference Architecture) with the security and compliance controls of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 and ISO/IEC TR 3445:2022.

arxiv-2511-16462.title: Systems for detecting and measuring backgrounds with the SABRE South experiment
arxiv-2511-16462.creator: L. J. Milligan
arxiv-2511-16462.description: Abstract The SABRE (Sodium iodide with Active Background REjection) experiment aims to detect an annual rate modulation from dark matter interactions in ultra-high purity NaI(Tl) crystals which will provide a model independent test of the signal observed by DAMA/LIBRA. SABRE will consist of two separate detectors in the Northern and Southern hemispheres.

pmc-11508543.title: HIV-Associated Neurocognitive Disorder (HAND) and Alzheimer’s Disease Pathogenesis: Future Directions for Diagnosis and Treatment
pmc-11508543.creator: Mohammed Mustafa, Dominique Musselman, Dushyantha Jayaweera, Andrea da Fonseca Ferreira, George Marzouka, Chunming Dong, James K Bashkin
pmc-11508543.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). HIV-associated neurocognitive disorder (HAND) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD) are two neurocognitive disorders with overlapping clinical presentations and pathophysiology. The two have been thought to be two separate entities. However, the introduction and widespread use of antiretroviral therapy (ART) has altered the clinical manifestations of HAND, shifting from a pattern of subcortical dementia to one more akin to cortical dementia, resembling AD. Thus, the line between the two disease entities is not clear-cut.

pmc-11716955.title: Healthy Aging Through the Senior Years (HATS) Study: A longitudinal cohort study of brain health and dementia among Black older adults in the United States
pmc-11716955.creator: Kerry M Sheets, David S Knopman, Ronald C Petersen, Prashanthi Vemuri, Clarence Jones, Anne Murray
pmc-11716955.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe higher prevalence and incidence of later life dementia among older Black Americans compared to older White Americans is incompletely understood and understudied. HATS is designed as a companion to the Mayo Clinic Study of Aging (MCSA) with a focus on identification of modifiable cardiovascular contributions to brain health among Black older adults living in urban areas in the upper Midwest.MethodHATS is enrolling 300 U.S. Black Minnesotans from the Twin Cities area aged 55 to 90 years without advanced dementia.

pmc-12505727.title: Salivary small extracellular vesicles reveal protein signatures in young patients with coronary artery disease
pmc-12505727.creator: Pratibha Sharma, Meetanshi Sancheti, Krishna Kishore Inampudi, Ambuj Roy, Rajinder K Dhamija
pmc-12505727.description: BackgroundSaliva-derived small extracellular vesicles (sEVs) are emerging as potential biomarkers for coronary artery disease (CAD). Early identification of these biomarkers is essential for effective management and improved patient outcomes. Our study aimed to isolate and characterize sEVs from saliva to identify non-invasive protein signatures in younger CAD patients.

pmc-13141506.title: Enable CAR T cell immunotherapy in glioblastoma by modifying its microenvironment via oncolytic adenovirus encoding bispecific T cell engager
pmc-13141506.creator: Moon Jung Choi, Eui Young So, Bedia Akosman, Young Eun Lee, Alexander G Raufi, Anthony M Reginato, Clark C Chen, Sean E Lawler, Eric T Wong, Olin D Liang
pmc-13141506.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Recent clinical trials show that CAR T cell therapies can initially blunt tumor growth in patients with glioblastoma (GBM). However, therapeutic efficacy remains limited by the immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment and restricted immune cell trafficking across the blood-brain barrier (BBB). To counteract these challenges, we have utilized the oncolytic adenovirus (OV) Ad5-Δ24-RGD as a platform to overexpress a bispecific T cell engager (BiTE) targeting both CD3 on T cells and the GBM-specific tumor associated antigen IL-13Rα2.

pmc-13631067.creator: Yifei Wang, Chenyang Gao, Ying Han, Jinling Zhang, Junying Wang, Shuai Han, Huan Ouyang, Lanyu Jia, Weihang Zhai, Jianghong He, Peijing Rong

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.
